chapter: Band personalities, Duke's last years and the office
title: Al Celley's vanishing act in Europe
summary: Celley, who couldn't see well, supposedly disappeared in Europe with $30,000 to $40,000.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: What about Al Kelley? Do you ever hear from him?
No, no. I think he is in Pennsylvania somewhere -- near Philadelphia.
I knew that was where he had his home, but I understand he almost -- you know, he couldn't hardly see anything.
Especially the one eye -- it was worse than the other one.
But he never made a mistake with money, though.
I understand he was the one who left
Duke Ellington and took all the money from ...
That's what Duke said; Duke said that he disappeared in Europe.
